new_abstractions: No new abstraction: reuse the existing generic per-leaf Bash matcher (evaluateBashToolUse) and autonomousCompoundBashRecovery; the change is to route RunCommand into them and block pipes.
current_flow: Autonomous RunCommand permission goes through the reviewed-rule path (ToolExecutionPolicyService.evaluate -> evaluateAutonomousToolUse). A single command matches its RunCommand rule; a control-flow compound is treated as one unmatched command and falls to the deterministic hostJobId rails which cancel it ('no declared grant'). The setup card grant builder only handles single-leaf commands, so compounds get buttonless prose, and notifyJobSetupRequired emits both a progress card and a setup story.

criteria_map.compound-allowed-live: Route RunCommand through evaluateBashToolUse so a control-flow compound whose leaves each match a granted rule resolves allowed at the classifier-decision seam; assert with the live repro in ipc-permission-classifier-decision.test.ts.
criteria_map.generic-any-cli: Matching keys off per-leaf rule matching with no command-name coupling; test a non-date cross-cli compound (git && npm) allowed and an ungranted-leaf compound paused.
criteria_map.pipe-blocked: Block piped commands before per-leaf matching in evaluateBashToolUse; test a pipe stays denied.
criteria_map.grantable-card-button: In the grant builder, fall back to autonomousCompoundBashRecovery to emit every per-leaf RunCommand rule so the setup card Approve button works; test the emitted grant.
criteria_map.single-notification: In notifyJobSetupRequired, make a raised/already-pending prompt terminal so the pause emits one notification; test one message.

rounds.question: Should a compound of individually-granted commands auto-allow, or only offer a button?
rounds.chosen: auto-allow safe compounds (no new authority; each leaf already granted) plus a button for genuinely-new compounds

rounds.question: Do pipes get the same treatment as && / || / ;?
rounds.chosen: keep pipe a hard boundary (piped data can be executed as program text)

citations.finding: single date matched RunCommand(date +*) but the && compound was cancelled by deterministic_rails
setup card grant builder uses persistentAutonomousBashRecoveryRule (single-leaf) and returns null for compounds
